description: Takes a live site offline: its address stops working. Free. The saved design and the address are kept, so the site can be published again later. Called with only the designId, nothing changes and it returns a confirmationToken. Called again with the same designId and that confirmationToken, the site goes offline. If the result says the outcome is unknown, iter0_publish_status shows whether the site is still live, and the same confirmationToken can be used again. Only the site's owner can take it offline.

confirmationToken.description: Leave out on the first call. On the second call pass the token the first call returned, unchanged.

designId.description: The saved design, from iter0_get_design or iter0_list_my_designs.

name: iter0_unpublish_site
title: Take a site offline
